conditional_artifacts.artifacts/CHECK_EXECUTIONS.jsonl: activated because exact lock-backed matrix executions are material to changing the baseline action
conditional_artifacts.artifacts/FAILURE_ATTRIBUTION.json: not activated unless a real failure or competing causal explanation appears
conditional_artifacts.artifacts/STOPPING_EVALUATION.json: not activated; stopping can be represented in operations, decision, and follow-up unless cost becomes a primary case question

raw_capture_policy: Preserve bounded public evidence sufficient for exact identity, baseline inputs, dependency resolution, upstream caution scope, repository usage, CI authority, action change, and validation.
